The 2025 physical study uses an imposed robot-disruption scenario and validates generated configurations before execution. All 20 trials eventually find valid reassignments, but only 12 do so on the first attempt; this is not unrestricted end-to-end robot task success. The timing table reverses its minimum/maximum labels, so those figures are not adopted.

The April 2026 verification paper measures safety-rule satisfaction in generated plans, with expert-validated formal specifications. Its percentages are not physical task success or guarantees of general robot safety. The paper is used for current methods activity rather than additional hardware credit.

The August 2026 journal paper is verified through the official university publication record and publicly visible publisher sections, not a fully retrieved publisher article. Hardware credit rests on the fully read 2024–25 papers; do not assume all 2026 case-study details were reviewed.

Reuse the Penn State institutional note: AC01’s bachelor-level external-affiliation minimum appears compatible with external graduate students, subject to academic and separate immigration approval. The J-1 guidance is under review; personal funding and the listed duration do not guarantee the proposed visit.
Public robot research does not confirm current equipment access, a summer 2027 offer or host availability.
